tests.name: the Studio age axis is organizer-defined, discloses no age validation, and no longer offers Youth
a saved configuration that already contains Youth still loads and derives

requirement: Studio age categories (Adult, Senior and any the organizer adds) are organizer-defined classifications, not governing-body age divisions: no thresholds, no automatic age-range validation (disclosed beside the age axis), and no correspondence to any body class. Studio 'Youth' is not offered while OD-02 prohibits under-18 competitors; saved configurations that contain it still load and OD-02 still applies.
enforcement_point: Display layer (axis note, offered values). OD-02 enforcement is PR 835. The age axis still allows organizer-typed custom values, so a typed 'Youth' is possible; OD-02 refuses under-18 competitors regardless.
interpretation_notes: Design opportunity (NOT implemented, separate review needed): organizer-configurable age ranges would need explicit thresholds, validation, audit history and a compatibility review of saved configurations. Other age values offered by non-Studio schemes (Country Junior, Ballroom Pre-Teen/Junior/Youth, WCS Juniors) are outside this change and still list under-18 divisions.
